candidate_definition: grid cells usable as an ambulance standby post: inside the municipality, resident population above zero, and at least 1 km from every existing 119 안전센터; no top-population exclusion, because a standby post is a parking spot and not a building

grid.envelope_basis: demand_population.csv representative points plus one cell margin

existing_bases_are_posts: the 10 existing 119 안전센터 are standby posts as well; they are added by scripts/build_municipal_standby_inputs.py, not listed in this file
population_allocation_note: cell_population_estimate is an estimate: the 행정동 resident population divided evenly among the grid cells whose centre falls in that 행정동 (uniform within-동 allocation).
haversine_note: Haversine great-circle distance is used here ONLY as a site-eligibility rule (minimum separation from existing facilities), never as a travel time.
administrative_membership_source: Kakao Local coord2regioncode (region_type H = 행정동, B = 법정동)
